disagreement_records.original_value: A:I were left untouched. The extracted figure/table layout is partly garbled, although the quoted metrics and counts used here are legible. The world-model classification is bounded to condition-specified acquisition/observation prediction; the paper does not demonstrate treatment-conditioned physiological dynamics, causal treatment effects, long-term disease progression, or planning/control. Evidence QA: 52/72 populated fields had a <=25-word quotation matching extracted PDF text (72.2%). Confidence is conservative; review this row where exact quote checks were incomplete.
disagreement_records.proposed_value: Current isolated return proposes only E (arXiv) and F (preprint) corrections; workbook remains unchanged. Assigned PDF SHA-256 matches. Full-text cache covers 26 page chunks and maps the version/title/page count, but cache provenance is not cryptographically tied to the PDF hash. Inherited visual review covers pp. 1, 3, 4; p. 2 is incomplete and pp. 5–26 were not visually inspected. Figure/table inventory for later pages is caption/text-derived. Strict ontology membership remains unknown; legacy L2 is retained as acquisition-condition prediction, not treatment causality. Prior quotation-match statistics were not recomputed.
